== Ingredients ==
* 1 slab [[Cookbook:Pork|pork]] spareribs
* ¼ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Barbecue Rub|Barbecue Rub]]
* 1 cup [[Cookbook:Apple Cider|apple cider]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Cider Vinegar|cider vinegar]]
* 2 tbsp [[Cookbook:Worcestershire Sauce|Worcestershire sauce]]
* 2 tbsp [[Cookbook:Honey|honey]]
* 2 tbsp [[Cookbook:Soy Sauce|soy sauce]]

== Procedure ==
#Season pork with barbecue rub, and refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
#Combine wet ingredients and bring to a [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]] over high heat 5–10 minutes. Set aside.
#Place ribs in a 250°F smoker or a 250°F charcoal [[Cookbook:Grill|grill]] set for indirect heat and cook 5–6 hours or until meat falls off the bone.
#[[Cookbook:Brush|Brush]] generously with cider mixture and place on a medium high grill, turning and brushing with cider mixture until well browned.
#Remove and let rest 10 minutes. Serve with remaining cider mixture.

steps.text: Season pork with barbecue rub, and refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
Combine wet ingredients and bring to a boil over high heat 5–10 minutes. Set aside.
Place ribs in a 250°F smoker or a 250°F charcoal grill set for indirect heat and cook 5–6 hours or until meat falls off the bone.
Brush generously with cider mixture and place on a medium high grill, turning and brushing with cider mixture until well browned.
